population: PAPER_EVAL 319 positive + 2689 negative, role DEV, held_out_final false

keypoint_px.definition: Euclidean prediction-to-annotation distance, index by index, in original-image pixels after inference padding is removed
keypoint_px.correspondence: index-wise, NOT order-free; the contract text says Hungarian but the evaluator does not use it, which is why 90-degree index permutations register as large errors

gross20.definition: fraction of supervised keypoints with 2D error above 20 px

proj_at_Npx.definition: fraction of supervised keypoints within N px

nme.definition: keypoint error normalised by the projected cuboid diagonal
nme.note: introduced during V2-V5 diagnosis, after results were seen; never substituted for the frozen px metric
